text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Tuesday it lowered its rating for Noodle Kidoodle Inc to neutral in light of disappointing holiday sales.

-- Rodman said comparable store sales in the period between November 3 and December 28 fell two percent, which Rodman called "disappointing." Total sales climbed to $23.9 million from $13.6 million one year ago, Rodman said.
-- Lack of sales momentum and conservative store opening plans will likely prevent Noodle Kidoodle from achieving the expense leverage previously forecast, Rodman said.
-- Rodman also lowered its fourth-quarter earnings estimate to $0.15 from $0.26 and its estimate for fiscal 1997 to a loss of $0.51 from a loss of $0.40.
-- Noodle Kidoodle is a specialty toy retailer. Its stock was down 1-5/8 Tuesday afternoon at 4-1/4.
